subject: history
concept: Understanding that different regions of the world have different climates and landscapes
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts region picture cards (desert, rainforest, arctic, grassland) by climate features
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a climate type to the region of the world it's found in
exercise.abstract: Student describes one feature of a named world region's climate

misconception_flags: assumes climate is the same everywhere in the world

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
